name: per-datum-egress-post-leak
description: Per-datum EGRESS, LEAK path. The session (auditor-1) reads entry-100 — audience {auditor-1} — then posts it VERBATIM to board-team, which auditor-9 can also read. auditor-9 is not in the datum's reader set, so the egress gate detects a PER-DATUM leak (tool_call_leak_per_datum), raises an info_leakage approval rather than hard-denying, and the post proceeds only once approved. This is the same board a real model might post any entry to; what makes THIS post a leak is the datum, resolved per-datum — the coarse floor could not tell entry-100 from a shareable entry. autoApprove clears the info_leakage card as auditor-1 (the session's approver), so the run completes. approvalPrompts pins that exactly one card was raised — the leak was detected, not silently allowed. The post reuses the wrapped read result via Expect.Capture, exactly as a real model copies a tool result.
